shared_head:
You are a game programmer. Write ONE complete, self-contained HTML5 canvas game in a single code block. No external assets, no CDNs, no network calls — all art is canvas shapes/particles, all sound is WebAudio oscillators (optional). Pure vanilla JS. It must run by double-clicking the file.

THE GAME — a minimal 'Dark Souls meets Diablo 2' slice, top-down. Working title: MUD (it is intentionally early; correctness over polish, but it must RUN and be genuinely playable in 2 minutes).

REQUIRED MECHANICS (all of these, working):
1. Player: WASD/arrows move, mouse aims, left-click or Space = attack (sword arc), Shift = dodge-roll with i-frames. A STAMINA bar drains on attack/roll, regenerates when idle — no stamina, no action (souls rule).
2. Diablo DNA: enemies drop LOOT with 4 rarity tiers (gray/white, blue, yellow/gold, orange) with random affixes (e.g. +damage, +speed, +max stamina, +life on kill); simple inventory: picked items auto-equip if better, hotkeys 1/2 toggle between two weapons; XP bar, level-ups grant a stat point (3 stats: Might, Vigor, Swiftness) spendable with keys Z/X/C or a tiny level-up panel.
3. Souls DNA: enemies drop SOULS (currency, orange orbs that fly to you); on DEATH you drop all souls at your death spot, respawn at the last BONFIRE (a checkpoint circle — standing in it heals and respawns all enemies); walk over your dropped souls to recover them; dying again before recovering loses them forever.
4. Enemies: 3 types minimum — melee walker (chases), ranged spitter (keeps distance, fires slow projectiles), and a fast dodger. Plus ONE BOSS at the far end of the map with 2 attack patterns and a health bar at screen bottom when engaged. Boss death = victory screen with time + deaths counted, then 'press R to loop (NG+)': enemies +30% damage/speed each loop.
5. Map: one hand-authored arena (walls/rocks as rectangles for collision) ~2 screens wide, camera follows player. Bonfire at start, another mid-map.
6. Juice (cheap but real): hit flashes, screen shake on player hurt, floating damage numbers, loot beam colors by rarity, particle poofs on death.

CODE QUALITY BAR: single file, <1000 lines, no libraries; fixed-timestep or delta-time loop; simple AABB collision; all state in a few objects; no crashes when things overlap; canvas letterboxed to window; title screen says 'MUD — press any key'; death and victory screens as described. If you must cut scope, cut juice first, never the souls-death loop or stamina.

OUTPUT: one complete HTML file in a single code block, nothing else. No explanations.

lanes.context: Variant A: prioritize feel — make the dodge-roll generous (long i-frames), stamina forgiving, combat readable. Err toward the player feeling powerful early, squeezed by loop 3.
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.

lanes.context: Variant B: prioritize the souls loop — make souls recovery tense (souls decay 1%/sec while dropped), bonfires sparse, the boss aggressive. Err toward tension.
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.

lanes.context: Variant C: prioritize the Diablo loop — more affix variety (6+ affixes), visible item tooltips on hover/pickup, enemies scale per player level. Err toward build variety.
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.
